_comment: Exact newsletter consent checkbox text per version and language. Never edit a published version: add a new one, point current at it, and every subscriber keeps the version they agreed to (stored with their record). [[text|/path]] marks a link on the form; the stored and exported wording is the text without the brackets. No version mentions services; add one that does only after the Vercel plan and the lawyer review allow it. TR and AR are translations by Claude, awaiting review.

v1-2026-10.EN: I agree to receive emails from AMD NSRI about new projects, journal articles and updates to its digital tools. I can unsubscribe at any time.
v1-2026-10.TR: AMD NSRI'dan yeni projeler, günlük yazıları ve dijital araçlarındaki güncellemeler hakkında e-posta almayı kabul ediyorum. Aboneliğimden istediğim zaman çıkabilirim.
v1-2026-10.AR: أوافق على تلقّي رسائل بريد إلكتروني من AMD NSRI حول المشاريع الجديدة ومقالات المدونة وتحديثات أدواتها الرقمية. ويمكنني إلغاء الاشتراك في أي وقت.

v2-2026-10.TR: AMD NSRI bültenini, yeni projeler, günlük yazıları ve dijital araç güncellemeleri hakkında e-posta ile almak istiyorum. [[Açık Rıza Beyanı|/consent]]'nı okudum ve kabul ediyorum; aboneliğimden istediğim zaman çıkabilirim.
v2-2026-10.EN: I want to receive the AMD NSRI newsletter by email, about new projects, journal articles and digital tool updates. I have read and accept the [[Explicit Consent Statement|/consent]], and I can unsubscribe at any time.
v2-2026-10.AR: أرغب في تلقّي النشرة البريدية لـ AMD NSRI عبر البريد الإلكتروني، حول المشاريع الجديدة ومقالات المدونة وتحديثات الأدوات الرقمية. وقد قرأت [[بيان الموافقة الصريحة|/consent]] وأوافق عليه، ويمكنني إلغاء الاشتراك في أي وقت.
